{"metadata":{"description":"Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds (Dream-RSI) for LLM agents","id":"gh:1378413092","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"open-dream-rsi","slug":"patrykorwat/open-dream-rsi","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","mcp","mcp-server","self-improvement"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds (Dream-RSI) for LLM agents"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Open Dream-RSI"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## What is this?"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Every AI agent pays the same tax over and over: it fails a task, works out
what went wrong, and then"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" throws that understanding away when the session
ends. Open Dream-RSI keeps what was learned — **wit"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"hout touching the model**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The LLM stays **frozen**. What improves is everything *around* it:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- the **exploration policy** (even re-written as Python code by the LLM
itself, gated by replay befo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"re it is trusted),
- a library of **verified solutions** (recipes) reused as warm starts,
- and the "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"**world model** the policy is scored against: a Discovery Tree of
every attempt, enriched with repla"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"y-safe error-class facts by the Sentinel
engine."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Between runs the system "dreams": it replays thousands of strategies over
the recorded history in-pr"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ocess, at **zero API cost**, and keeps only what
beats the incumbent. An open implementation of *Rec"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ursive Self-Improvement
through Evolving Worlds* (Dream-RSI, Zheng et al.,
arXiv:2609.14858)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Zero runtime dependencies** — Python 3.10+ stdlib only, ~8.6k lines of
library code, ~4.4k lines o"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"f tests, no build step."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Not another memory plugin.** Experience-memory systems record what the
agent learned and reuse it "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"as-is. ODR is an *evolving worlds* loop: every
attempt is recorded into a Discovery Tree, and betwee"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"n runs the system
dreams — replaying thousands of strategy variants against that recorded
world. Not"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"hing is promoted on the model's word alone: a candidate policy or
recipe replaces the incumbent only"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" after surviving counterfactual replay."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**How it compares** — stored state, how entries earn trust, runtime cost,
against Mem0, Letta, Refle"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"xion-style reflection, DSPy optimizers and skill
libraries: docs/comparison.md."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> **📄 Preprint:** *Open Dream-RSI: An Open-Source Library for Recursive
> Self-Improvement Around a "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"Frozen LLM, with Replay-Gated Learned Policies and
> a Curated Knowledge Base* — P. Orwat, 2026.
> *"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"*PDF** · **LaTeX source**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. **Online execution** — the agent attempts each task with the real LLM and
a sandboxed verifier, a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ppending every attempt to a per-task
*Discovery Tree* (code, test feedback, score, one-line plan, an"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"d — when a
Sentinel engine is wired — structured error-class facts and an explicit
termination reaso"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"n).
2. **Offline dreaming** — instead of paying for real-world rollouts, the
agent "dreams" over the"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" recorded history: thousands of strategy variants
are scored in an in-process replay simulator at ze"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ro external-call cost.
The best parameters, programs and recipes are persisted and steer the
next cy"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"xternal-call cost.
The best parameters, programs and recipes are persisted and steer the
next cycle."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Beyond parameter-level dreaming, the loop closes section 3 of the paper
("dreaming with code"): each"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" cycle the LLM may **rewrite the exploration
policy itself** as a small Python program, `choose_acti"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"on(frontier, step)`.
Candidates are statically validated (AST gate), executed only in a hardened
sub"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"process sandbox, and scored by **counterfactual replay rollout** on the
recorded tree. A candidate r"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"eplaces the incumbent only on evidence — and
the incumbent is re-scored on the *current* tree, not t"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"rusted at its stored
score. A crashing or cheating policy can never break the loop: expansion
falls "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"back to the greedy baseline."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What persists between runs (`--memory` dir)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Artifact | File | Effect |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Dreamed policy parameters | `policies.json` | next cycle starts from the last one's optimum |
| Pr"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"omoted policy programs | `policy_codes.json` | LLM-written `choose_action` steers expansion |
| Reci"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"pe library | `recipes.json` | verified solutions replayed as warm starts |
| Discovery trees | `tree"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"s/` | offline dreaming always has history; nodes optionally carry replay-safe Sentinel facts |
| Aud"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"it log | `events.jsonl` | append-only record of every decision |
| Holdout reservations | `holdout_r"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"eservations.json` | preregistered eval task IDs consumed once (`odr holdout claim/split`) |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Switches worth knowing: `--no-policy-code`, `--no-knowledge`, `--no-thoughts`,
`--no-judge` ablate t"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"he four optional machinery layers; `--evolution-stop`
(opt-in) freezes policy regeneration after an "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"anytime-valid betting-martingale
alarm — no promotion evidence left in a category stops the spending"},{"id":"p19s4","text":", the last
promoted policy stays active; `--budget N` caps API calls per cycle (dreaming
stays free)"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" the last
promoted policy stays active; `--budget N` caps API calls per cycle (dreaming
stays free)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Candidate code — both task solutions and policy programs — runs in a
hardened subprocess (`open_drea"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"m_rsi/sandbox.py`): `python -I`, scrubbed
environment (only `PATH` — API keys never cross the wall),"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" a timeout that
kills the **entire process group**, and POSIX address-space / CPU /
thread-count lim"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"its. Policy code additionally passes an AST gate *before*
any spawn: required entry point, no import"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"s, no dunder access, no
`__builtins__` reference (name plus constructed-key indexing is itself an
es"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" access, no
`__builtins__` reference (name plus constructed-key indexing is itself an
escape route)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**This is defence in depth, not a container.** The subprocess does not
restrict filesystem or networ"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"k access, and an AST gate cannot be provably
complete against code that is not statically gated. For"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" hostile task
sources set `ODR_SANDBOX_CMD` to a
bubblewrap/nsjail wrapper
(e.g. `bwrap --unshare-al"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"l --die-with-parent --ro-bind / /`) or run the
loop inside a container."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"On non-POSIX hosts (Windows) the same `python -I` child runs, but there are
no rlimits and the timeo"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ut kills only the direct child — treat Windows as
out of scope for hostile task sources. When `ODR_S"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ANDBOX_CMD` is unset,
each fresh process logs a one-time warning naming exactly this gap."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Module architecture"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Module | Role |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| `core.tree` | DiscoveryTree — hypotheses, results, actions, thoughts, Sentinel facts, termination "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"reason |
| `core.simulator` | replay simulation without touching the environment |
| `core.dreamer` "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"| offline optimisation over recorded history |
| `core.agent` | LLM agent driven by the rewarded pol"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"icy |
| `core.policygen` | policy generation, AST gate, rollout scoring, promotion |
| `core.judge` "},{"id":"p26s5","text":"| completion judge for test-less (`criteria`) tasks |
| `loop` | `AutoRSIRuntime` — the autonomous s"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"upervisor (opt-in `sentinel_engine`) |
